description_en: Queries the details of attack source IP addresses for a specific volumetric attack event
description_zh: 查询某次流量型攻击的攻击来源IP详情
name: DescribeDDosEventSrcIp

parameters.help_en:
The type of the attack event to query. Valid values:

defense: traffic scrubbing events for volumetric attacks.
blackhole: blackhole filtering events for volumetric attacks
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的攻击事件的类型。取值：

defense：表示流量型攻击清洗事件。
blackhole：表示流量型攻击黑洞事件
parameters.name: event_type

parameters.help_en:
The start timestamp of the event to query. Unit: seconds.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188604.html to query the start time of all events
parameters.help_zh:
要查询事件的开始时间戳，单位：秒。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188604.html查询所有事件的开始时间信息
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The attacked IP Address of Anti-DDoS Proxy instance
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en: The number of attack source IP addresses to return. The IP addresses are sorted by attack traffic in descending order. Default value: 5
parameters.help_zh: 要返回的攻击来源IP的个数。按照攻击流量由大到小排序，默认返回前5个IP
parameters.name: range

Ips.description_en: The information about attack source IP addresses

AreaId.description_en: The region code of the attack source. For more information, see [Region codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/167926.html）. For example, 110000 indicates Beijing, China, and us indicates the United States
AreaId.description_zh: 攻击来源地域的代码。更多信息，请参见[地域代码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/167926.html）。例如，**110000**表示中国北京市、**us**表示美国
